title: Release B, part 5 (again, with part 6): a broken reader no longer wipes a site's facts, searches that find nothing become work, Closed made stricter, Gemini's w
why: decisions/0163 §8's gap list (research/knowledge-engine-gap-review-2026-11-14.md): P6-1, P1-3, F2, F3, F4. Jason, 2026-11-15: finish Release B without waiting for his keys. Everything ships off; the master switch stays off. (1) Parser drift (P6-1): a read of a site that finds nothing on pages that had facts used to delete those facts; now they're kept (shown with 'last checked'), and after two such reads 'The engine needs a person' asks for a reader fix, naming the site and its pages. (2) A search that finds nothing (P1-3): recorded as demand for the place searched or the searcher's area, named or not; a kind of place becomes that kind's job in the town (from our own kinds, never the words), a topic waits as one of W6's gaps. (3) The public confirms Closed (F2): three answers on at least two days within 60 days, none saying open since. (4) Three states only (F3): the listing says 'Still open?' with the source's own words; 'Possibly closed' and 'Reported closed' are retired, and a Closed listing isn't scored down. (5) Gemini (F4): its daily allowance is paced to be used, so it warns only on the unexpected: background work at its stop before 18:00 UTC three days running, or the visitors' reserve under 5%. No database update: #65 failed staging's 'Migrations only add' check (its migration changed a column's type), so an empty search is now recorded as 'lacking' (results lacking), a value the column already has; #65 is withdrawn. Also part 6: (6) a source whose licence tightens (gap review P4-2): its stored facts stop feeding new listings at once, and a step in 'The engine needs a person' counts the listing facts resting only on it, with Take them off (kept as taken off, never written back; names, map points and towns left for a person); (7) Google's check order (decisions/0163 §12): never checked first, then a listing with a phone and no website, then one at the score line (35, W1's setting); order only. Tests: staging unit 49, identity 36, Gemini guards 21. Built on Sync 2026-11-15 20:11 UTC.
